verdict.line: You lose if you get caught by Hookshot near a wall before your W is up; you win if you all-in at 4 Ionian Fervor stacks while her Precision Protocol is down.

brief.thesis: Camille's entire combo depends on Hookshot finding a wall and Precision Protocol landing clean, but Defiant Dance's damage reduction lets Irelia eat that burst mid-charge and Bladesurge resets off anything Flawless Duet marks, so Irelia converts single exchanges into full trades. That structural mismatch is why Irelia sits at 53.4% over 461 games despite Camille's higher raw mobility.

theirWindow.when: Camille is near a wall with E up
theirWindow.what: She can Hookshot off terrain into a knockup and chain Q's empowered auto plus W's cone slow; don't stand near walls once she hits level 3 unless your W is also ready.

yourWindow.when: You have 4 Ionian Fervor stacks, her Q is down
yourWindow.what: Engage with Q (Bladesurge) into E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then Q again to consume the reset; the bonus on-hit damage from max Passive stacks wins the extended trade before she can recast Precision Protocol.

start.why: The sustain and early AD trade damage let you match Camille's Precision Protocol pokes without losing the lane of attrition (52.5% WR, 89.4% pick).

boots.why: Camille's damage is almost entirely physical autos and Q/E follow-ups, so flat physical reduction blunts her all-in harder than any other boot option (53.7% WR, 82.3% pick).

core.why: Current-health damage and the on-hit slow let you stick to Camille through her E dash-away and punish her lack of hard disengage.
Single-target damage scaling turns every Q-reset auto into a bigger duel swing, the strongest of the listed paths at 55.9% WR.
Magic resist plus attack speed shreds through her passive Adaptive Defenses shield faster and keeps your on-hit stacking relevant.

situational.when: she or her team is stacking burst you need to spread out over time
you're already ahead and want to close out fights faster (67.4% WR path)
the enemy team has a burst combo that can delete you before you land your own
the enemy composition is heavy on magic damage or hard CC beyond Camille

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping adaptive damage that converts to healing at max stacks directly offsets Camille's passive shield and Tactical Sweep heal in a prolonged trade.

summoners.why: Ignite denies the passive shield and W sustain that let Camille stabilize a bad trade, and it's the dominant pick in the data at 52.4% WR and 89.3% pick rate.

playing.title: Track her Q charge state
playing.detail: Precision Protocol (cooldown 9-5s) empowers her next auto and can be recast after a delay for much higher damage. If she's holding the recast window, back off rather than trading into it.

playing.title: Respect walls once she's level 3
playing.detail: Hookshot (cooldown 16-12s, range 800) needs terrain to fire and knocks up on landing. Don't stand near a wall with her E up unless your W is also ready to eat the follow-up.

playing.title: W through her burst window
playing.detail: Defiant Dance takes reduced physical damage while charging. Hold the charge to absorb her Q-empowered auto or the knockup combo, then release the full-charge strike into her.

playing.title: All-in only at max Passive stacks
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor grants bonus on-hit damage at maximum Attack Speed stacks. Bait a stack-building auto or spell hit before committing to the all-in rather than engaging cold.

playing.title: Chain E into Q for the reset
playing.detail: Bladesurge (cooldown 10-6s) fully refreshes if the target is Marked or dies to it, and Flawless Duet applies that Mark on its stun. Land E first so your follow-up Q resets instantly.

playing.title: Punish her cooldown gaps
playing.detail: After she spends E to engage or Q to poke, her damage drops off hard for several seconds. Use that window to shove the wave or force a second trade she can't answer.

playing.title: Save Ignite for the first real skirmish
playing.detail: Her passive shield and W heal keep close fights alive; burning Ignite early denies that sustain and converts a marginal trade into a kill.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune page, boots, and matchup percentages are measured from real games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the cooldown timings and trade-window reasoning are my own read of the kits, not aggregate stats.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Camille’s (E). Absorb Camille’s (Q) with a well-timed [W], while engaging when Irelia has 4 stacks [P] ready.
